Title: Announcing Azure Data Explorer data connector for Azure Synapse

Body.Content:
Azure Data Explore data connector for Azure Synapse Workspace is now available in preview. This is an extension of Azure Data Explorer Spark connector that is now natively integrated into Azure Synapse Apache Spark pools that enables smooth access to Azure Data Explore with AAD pass-through authentication, secure credentials management, and Synapse workspace experience to improve developer productivity and easy integration with the rest of your big data solution. 

Read the blog for more information.
